title: Finite-free computation of localized mixed derived pullback
statement: Let W be an open of T, V an open of U.toScheme, U an open of S, and g:V.toScheme -> W.toScheme. Supply independent derived localizations on T, W and the module site localized over V. For every bounded-above complex P on T with finite free terms and additive functor L isomorphic to tensor pullback along g followed by W.ι and the inverse overEquiv V, the localizedMixedDerivedPullback(U,V,W,g) of the exact restriction to W of Q(P) is isomorphic to Q(L(P)), where L acts termwise. This assertion has no direct-image morphism or cartesian-square data.

proof.text: Finite free terms are flat, so P is K-flat by bounded-above flat K-flatness. Exact open restriction is tensor pullback along the inclusion and preserves K-flatness.

Localization uniqueness intertwines Qh and hence Q. Exact functor factorization identifies transported restriction with the standard localization of the restricted complex. Apply flatComplexDerivedPullback to the bounded-above flat restricted complex and use its K-flat counit to compute derived pullback. Compose tensor pullbacks along g and W inclusion, apply the exact inverse localized-site equivalence, and use the supplied natural isomorphism with L termwise.
